title: File:Japanese cruiser Nachi maneuvering under air attack in Manila Bay, Philippines, on 5 November 1944 (80-G-287018).jpg
artist: Photographed by a plane from USS Essex (CV-9).
description: The Japanese heavy cruiser Nachi maneuvering under air attack from the U.S. Navy Task Group 38.3 in Manila Bay, Philippines, on 5 November 1944. Nachi was sunk in this attack.
